lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Skill consolidation: the triangle proportionality theorem

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 8 corresponds to DE = 24. If BC = 8, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 2 and 18. Find the altitude.
A 3 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 15 m shadow. How tall is the building?
choices: 9 m

items.prompt: Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.
This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 14 corresponds to DE = 56. If BC = 17, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 4 and 100. Find the altitude.
A 6 m pole casts a 4 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 32 m shadow. How tall is the building?
A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.
The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 15 corresponds to DE = 30. If BC = 6, find EF.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 3 and 3. Find the altitude.
A 7 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 25 m shadow. How tall is the building?
The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.
The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.
The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².
